local_checks.invariant: Test-mode database selection must not allow a shared database URL to pass the development/production guard and then be truncated by test setup.
local_checks.result: The test URL guard compares raw strings and checks substrings. A TEST_DATABASE_URL for the same shared database with an added connection option can differ from DATABASE_URL without containing either blocked name; the pool uses that accepted URL, and test setup subsequently truncates application tables. No target code or database was run.

local_checks.invariant: The restore CLI must not direct destructive database operations to a shared server selected by environment configuration.
local_checks.result: PGHOST and PGPORT are environment-overridable with loopback defaults. The maintenance pool uses those values, then unconditionally drops the fixed pipeline_restore_test database on that server. The source contains no check that an override remains local or that the target is disposable. No target code or database was run.

unresolved: Whether a lower-trust runner or caller can set TEST_DATABASE_URL to an alias of a shared database, and whether the installed pg parser treats the alternate URL as the same database, requires bounded local validation.

Whether PGHOST overrides can reach a shared server containing pipeline_restore_test, and whether the configured role can drop it, depends on runtime environment and grants not established by repository source.
hardening: The restore utility defaults PGHOST to 127.0.0.1 and uses a fixed pipeline_restore_test destination, but environment overrides are not constrained.

The restore source database is selected separately through TEST_DB_NAME while setupTestDatabase uses TEST_DATABASE_URL. pg_dump writes to .db/restore_temp.sql, and cleanup occurs only on the successful path. Source does not establish a lower-trust reader of that ignored file, so this remains a hardening note.

local_checks.result: A member can store a displayName up to 100 characters; the service trims and stores it without restricting markup, and the member-list query returns it to organization users. The task-create modal interpolates each active member displayName directly into an option template and parses it with insertAdjacentHTML. Sibling raw displayName sinks occur in the current user navigation and profile form, and profile skills/interests also enter that user profile form without escaping; these paths are self-only. Member directory/detail names, task fields, announcements, finance values and errors are escaped. Auth/invitation errors inspected are fixed or schema-generated; local invitation email errors are same-user only; remaining raw role/status values are constrained enums. Browser parsing and event execution were not tested.
